notes.title: TRIVIA WAR 2.0
notes.content:
Trivia War 2.0 is Here! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce a major update to Trivia War! Here's everything that's new in Version 2.0:

🔧 Gameplay Overhaul
The Gameplay Settings have been completely revamped and can now be accessed before every game, eliminating the need to go to the settings screen!

🎮 New Game Modes
We’re introducing two brand new game modes to keep things fresh:

- Stealth Health: Test your strategy under pressure with everyone's health completely hidden!
- Arsenal Challenge: Upgrade your weapon based on your correct streak, lose your streak and start back at the beginning. 

⚡ New Speed Bonuses
Two exciting new Speed Bonuses have been added:

- Damage Increase: Deal more damage depending on what order the player answered correctly.
- Health Replenish: Have your health restored, the faster you answered the more health you gain back!

🛠️ Enhanced Customization
You now have more control over your game experience:

- Adjust Question Time: Set how much time you have to answer each question.
- Adjust Answer Time: Control how much time you have to pick your answer.
- Filter Categories & Difficulty: Filter out categories you don’t enjoy and select your preferred difficulty levels.
- Multiple Guesses: Allow multiple guesses per round for added strategy!

🌟 Additional Features
- Screen Shake: Explosions now have a screen shake effect to make things even more intense! (Can be turned off in the settings)
- Bluetooth Controller Delay Fix: We've added a grace period to account for potential delays when using Bluetooth controllers.
- CPU Difficulty Settings: The CPU’s difficulty can now be set individually for a more tailored experience!

🎉 Win Screen Overhaul
The Win Screen has been redesigned to be more exciting and rewarding when you come out on top!

🐞 Bug Fixes
We've squashed a variety of bugs, including performance improvements and question fixes to make your game run smoother than ever.
